campos.Text:
B-cell maturation
Bone marrow
{{c1::Pro-B::P…}}: no complete μ chain or surface Ig
{{c1::Pre-B::P…}}: cytoplasmic μ and pre-BCR, no conventional light chain
{{c1::Immature B::I…}}: surface IgM, no IgD
Peripheral cells
{{c2::Mature naive B::M…}}: surface {{c3::IgM and IgD::I…}}
{{c2::Plasma cells::P…}}: antibody-secreting effectors
{{c2::Memory B cells::M…}}: persistent antigen-experienced B cells
campos.Extra: A productive heavy-chain rearrangement allows μ to pair with a surrogate light chain in the pre-BCR. Light-chain rearrangement then creates a complete IgM BCR. Mature naive B cells coexpress IgM and IgD by alternative RNA processing, not class-switch recombination. After antigen stimulation, activated clones can generate plasma cells or memory cells; those are alternative fates, not a required plasma-to-memory sequence.

campos.Text:
Barriers to antiviral therapy
Drug design
{{c1::Host dependence::H…}} leaves few virus-specific targets
{{c1::Viral diversity::V…}} limits broad coverage
Treatment
{{c2::Latency::L…}} can hide infected cells from replication-dependent drugs
{{c2::Late initiation::L…}} may follow substantial viral damage

card: O pâncreas é principalmente {{c1::retroperitoneal}}, com exceção da cauda no ligamento esplenorrenal.

campos.Text: O pâncreas é principalmente {{c1::retroperitoneal}}, com exceção da cauda no ligamento esplenorrenal.
campos.Extra: Most of the pancreas becomes fixed against the posterior abdominal wall during development. The tail reaches the splenic hilum within the splenorenal ligament, the important peritoneal exception.

card: Entre as refeições , a maior resistência do esfíncter da via biliar distal favorece o desvio da bile pelo {{c1::ducto cístico}} para a vesícula.

campos.Text: Entre as refeições, a maior resistência do esfíncter da via biliar distal favorece o desvio da bile pelo {{c1::ducto cístico}} para a vesícula.
campos.Extra: A patent cystic duct permits bile to enter the gallbladder when resistance to duodenal flow is higher. During a meal, gallbladder contraction and sphincter relaxation favor flow into the duodenum.

card: In the respiratory tract , the {{c1:: site of replication }} decides whether a virus causes rhinitis, laryngitis or pneumonia

campos.Text: In the respiratory tract, the {{c1::site of replication}} decides whether a virus causes rhinitis, laryngitis or pneumonia
campos.Extra: Infection at different airway levels produces different syndromes, from rhinitis to pneumonia. Lower-airway disease can impair gas exchange, but severity also depends on viral properties and host responses.

card: In resting memory B cells , EBV latency with no viral protein expression is type {{c1::0}}.

campos.Text: In resting memory B cells, EBV latency with no viral protein expression is type {{c1::0}}.
campos.Extra: Without viral protein production, infected resting cells avoid recognition by T cells directed against those viral antigens. Proliferating B cells in latency III express a broader protein program and are more readily recognized.

card: Rotavirus: mechanisms of diarrhea NSP4-driven chloride secretion produces {{c1::secretory}} diarrhea. Villus injury with unabsorbed lactose produces {{c1::osmotic}} diarrhea.

campos.Text:
Rotavirus: mechanisms of diarrhea
NSP4-driven chloride secretion produces {{c1::secretory}} diarrhea.
Villus injury with unabsorbed lactose produces {{c1::osmotic}} diarrhea.
campos.Extra: NSP4 promotes secretion, while enterocyte injury reduces absorptive capacity and brush-border lactase. Unabsorbed lactose retains water in the lumen, so both mechanisms can coexist.
campos.NEBLI_Comentario: CORRIGIDO, 05, 11, 26.
campos.NEBLI_Resposta: Cada linha distingue mecanismo pelo evento causal, com negrito visível e nomes específicos nas lacunas.

card: After a Cas9 cut , repair by NHEJ can insert or delete bases ({{c1::indels}}). A coding indel that shifts the reading frame may cause {{c2::loss of function}}.

campos.Text: After a Cas9 cut, repair by NHEJ can insert or delete bases ({{c1::indels}}). A coding indel that shifts the reading frame may cause {{c2::loss of function}}.
campos.Extra: Nonhomologous end joining repairs DNA ends without a homologous repair template. Processing can insert or delete bases; an indel not divisible by three shifts the coding frame. The outcome depends on position, allele and repair product, so a cut does not guarantee a knockout.

card: Guide–target pairing in RNA silencing: - Extensive pairing: {{c1::Argonaute cleavage}} - Partial pairing: {{c1::translational repression}} and mRNA decay

campos.Text:
Guide–target pairing in RNA silencing:
- Extensive pairing: {{c1::Argonaute cleavage}}
- Partial pairing: {{c1::translational repression}} and mRNA decay
campos.Extra: Extensive guide–target pairing can support Argonaute cleavage; partial pairing commonly promotes repression and mRNA decay. A guide complex can act on successive targets. Pairing, rather than RNA-class name alone, helps determine the outcome.

card: Viral injury: routes to host damage Replication in the infected cell : {{c1::cell destruction::c…}} or dysfunction. Host immune response : {{c1::inflammation::i…}}. Signals affecting neighboring cells

campos.Text:
Viral injury: routes to host damage
Replication in the infected cell: {{c1::cell destruction::c…}} or dysfunction.
Host immune response: {{c1::inflammation::i…}}.
Signals affecting neighboring cells: {{c1::paracrine effects::p…}}.
Persistent oncogenic change: {{c1::transformation::t…}}.
campos.Extra: These mechanisms can overlap. Rotavirus NSP4 can alter neighboring enterocytes without infecting them; oncogenic viruses can instead drive long-term changes in proliferation and survival.

card: Natural anti-A and anti-B are predominantly {{c1::IgM}}, whereas anti-Rh produced after Rh-antigen sensitization is {{c1::IgG}}.

campos.Text: Natural anti-A and anti-B are predominantly {{c1::IgM}}, whereas anti-Rh produced after Rh-antigen sensitization is {{c1::IgG}}.
campos.Extra: IgM does not cross the placenta, whereas IgG can reach fetal red cells. Rh sensitization can follow fetomaternal bleeding or transfusion, not necessarily only a first birth. Some anti-A/anti-B, especially in group O, are IgG and can cause neonatal hemolysis.
campos.NEBLI_Comentario: CORRIGIDO, 05, 11, 26.

card: Circulating immune complexes lodge where plasma is filtered under pressure, such as the {{c1::glomerulus}} and synovium

campos.Text: Circulating immune complexes lodge where plasma is filtered under pressure, such as the {{c1::glomerulus}} and synovium
campos.Extra: Immune-complex deposition activates complement and recruits inflammatory cells, injuring vessels and filtered tissues. Type III reactions can be systemic or localized, as in an Arthus reaction; circulating complexes do not make every example systemic.

card: On glomerular immunofluorescence for IgG , deposited immune complexes (type III) look {{c1::granular}}, while anti–basement membrane antibody (type II) looks {{c1::linear}}

campos.Text: On glomerular immunofluorescence for IgG, deposited immune complexes (type III) look {{c1::granular}}, while anti–basement membrane antibody (type II) looks {{c1::linear}}
campos.Extra: The left panel shows granular deposits in lupus; the right shows linear staining in anti-GBM disease. Uneven immune-complex deposits produce a granular pattern, while antibody binding along the basement membrane produces a continuous linear pattern.

card: In intracavitary studies , barium and iodine are {{c1::positive}} contrast because they raise attenuation, while air and CO2 are {{c1::negative}}

campos.Text: In intracavitary studies, barium and iodine are {{c1::positive}} contrast because they raise attenuation, while air and CO2 are {{c1::negative}}
campos.Extra: Barium and iodine attenuate X-rays strongly and appear bright. Gas attenuates weakly and appears dark; water is closer to soft tissue and is used as neutral enteric contrast. The barium-filled colon below demonstrates positive luminal contrast.

campos.Extra: The entry route determines which lumen fills. Fluoroscopy follows transit through the upper gut after swallowing; retrograde rectal filling outlines the colon and its mucosal contours.

card: Mast-cell activation may follow {{c1::IgE}} cross-linking or {{c1::non-IgE mechanisms}}.

campos.Text: Mast-cell activation may follow {{c1::IgE}} cross-linking or {{c1::non-IgE mechanisms}}.
campos.Extra: IgE-mediated activation follows cross-linking of receptor-bound IgE. Other pathways can activate mast cells without IgE, including direct receptor activation or complement-related mechanisms. Similar clinical manifestations do not prove the same molecular trigger.
